status: DRAFT TARGET — bound to the base figure only after the owner approves one; NOT a production standard
replaces: contract-v1.json (D-197) as the target. v1 stays a documented experiment: its fit was shown with derivatives of Northstar's own clothing and simulated generated input, never with a GPT-generated item, and its rule 'every item covers Northstar's tee/jeans/sneakers' is NOT carried over.
base: base-figure-spec-v1.json — one shared Northstar-style base figure in neutral, close-fitting base clothing (authoring only), continuous arms, legs and feet

canvas.coordinates: Northstar v2 master, unchanged; every item is a full-canvas RGBA layer set, the app never places an item individually

stack.what: item parts BEHIND the body: a hood's back, a skirt's or coat's inner back, a collar's back, a cape (D-196's back slot keeps its meaning)
BASE — torso, neck and shoulder skin, legs and feet; the base garments' regions are EMPTY
shoes and sandals; a sandal's straps lie over the feet
shorts, skirts, trousers; under the top's hem; over the shoe tops
OPTIONAL — a boot shaft drawn over a trouser leg (trousers tucked into boots)
the top's trunk; BEHIND the arms
OPTIONAL — a waistband over a tucked-in top, an overall's bib
sleeves and straps that lie OVER the arms; behind the hands
OPTIONAL — gloves and cuffs that lie over the hands; each narrows the hand protect for that one item only (D-134)
the R3 head stack, which owns the neck above y 440

top.mustCover: the base top's region + 1 px, opaque (≥ 250) — chest band from the neckline to the natural waist, with the straps
top.notRequired: sleeves, the shoulders outside the straps, the neck, anything below the natural waist
top.allowed: up to 14 px above the base neckline (the head stack hides a collar under the neck), out to 40 px beside the torso, down to 8 px above the crotch; sleeves anywhere in the sleeve zone up to the wrists
top.protect: the head and its neck band above the collar limit, the hands (2 px guard), everything below the crotch band
outOfScope: midriff-baring tops (need an owner decision on midriff skin)
necklines deeper than the base neckline
off-shoulder and halter cuts that leave a base strap uncovered

bottom.mustCover: the base shorts' region + 1 px, opaque (≥ 250) — the natural waist to mid-thigh
bottom.notRequired: the legs below the base shorts' hem
bottom.allowed: 30 px above the waist (under the top), 40 px beside the hips, down to 22 px above the ground; a skirt may flare out to 80 px beside the hips
bottom.protect: the hands (bottoms lie under them), the ground band, the feet below the ankle band
outOfScope: shorts and skirts shorter than the base shorts

shoes.required: PRODUCT CHOICE (open O3): technically optional, because the base has feet
shoes.groundRule: the soles stand on the ground line y 1488 ± 4 for each foot
shoes.allowed: the foot zone, 34 px beside it, up to 150 px above the ankle band

seams.neck: The head stack owns the neck above y 440 and lies over every top, so a collar runs under the neck. A top never draws above the collar limit (base neckline − 14 px).
seams.shoulders: Sleeveless tops end at the straps' width; every top must cover the straps. The base has shoulder skin, so the armhole may be anywhere outside the straps.
seams.arms: Sleeves (any length from none to the wrist) lie over the arms; the trunk lies behind them; sleeves never cover the hands (2 px guard). Cuffs over the hands are hands-over, one approved item at a time.
seams.waist: The top's hem lies over the bottom's waistband. The two mustCover regions overlap by 4 px either side of the natural waist, so no combination opens a gap. A tucked-in top uses bottoms-over.
seams.hips_and_hands: Bottoms lie under the hands; a skirt flares behind them.
seams.knees: Shorts and skirts end anywhere between the base shorts' hem and the ankle; the base legs show below.
seams.ankles: Bottoms lie over the shoe tops down to 22 px above the ground; a boot drawn over the trousers uses shoes-over.
seams.feet: Shoes lie over the feet; a sandal's open parts show the base feet.

hardCombinations: sleeveless top + shorts + sandals (most skin; every base seam visible)
waist-length top + high-waist skirt (the waist overlap)
long-sleeve top + gloves (sleeves over arms, cuffs over hands)
hoodie + wide trousers + boots over the trousers (back, bottoms, shoes-over)
gatesPerItem: D-197's I1–I8 (layers, coverage, envelope, protect, alpha, outline, sharpness, ground/sleeve split) apply unchanged, with mustCover, allowed and protect taken from this contract on the APPROVED base figure — never from Northstar's tee, jeans or sneakers.
boundTo: nothing yet — the templates are built from the approved base figure's measured base garments; until then they exist only as the target ranges in base-figure-spec-v1.json
